decisions.rationale: Lead Meowscarada + Mamoswine to outspeed and break Aerodactyl Focus Sash while threatening Empoleon and Gengar. Meowscarada's 192 Speed outspeeds entire opposing team; Mamoswine's Ice Shard handles Dragonite and Aerodactyl. Avoid Incineroar lead to prevent triggering Competitive Empoleon. Back Metagross (intended Mega) to sweep after Gengar is removed, and Hatterene for TrickRoom control if speed control is lost. Rotom-Heat benched as it's slower and less impactful than the chosen four.
decisions.notebook: Opponent favors Aerodactyl + Competitive Empoleon leads to trigger SpA boosts and control speed. Mega Gengar deployed as fast special sweeper hard-countering Steel/Psychic types. Competitive Empoleon Hydro Pump OHKOes Incineroar; Modest Flash Cannon OHKOes Hatterene. Dragonite relies on intact Multiscale + Lum Berry to survive priority. Avoid leading Incineroar into Competitive Empoleon. Meowscarada's speed tier (192) outspeeds all opposing threats including Mega Gengar (max 200 raw but Timid nature). Mamoswine Ice Shard priority essential for breaking Multiscale Dragonite and Focus Sash Aerodactyl. Metagross-Mega with Tough Claws is primary win condition after Gengar removal. Hatterene TrickRoom provides speed control backup plan.

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Gengar-Mega. Gengar + Empoleon turn-one job: Empoleon immediately punishes Incineroar's Intimidate via Competitive (+2 SpA) while Mega Gengar provides Shadow Tag trapping and outspeeds Mega Metagross with super-effective Shadow Ball. Backline Dragonite and Arcanine complete the plan with Extreme Speed priority cleanup, Multiscale durability, and secondary Intimidate support against physical attackers.

Knock Off removes Gengar's Gengarite, preventing Mega Evolution and Shadow Tag—critical since Mega Gengar hard-counters our team. Earthquake hits both foes 2x (Gengar Ghost weak to Ground, Empoleon Steel weak to Ground). Even if Empoleon survives and Flash Cannons Mamoswine, eliminating Gengar's Mega potential is priority #1. Meowscarada's 192 Speed ensures it moves before Gengar's max 178.
decisions.notebook: Gengarite on active Gengar is the highest-priority removal target—preventing Mega Gengar/Shadow Tag is essential. Competitive Empoleon punishes stat-lowering moves; avoid Intimidate leads. Mamoswine Earthquake is the primary spread damage tool but triggers Competitive if Empoleon survives. Meowscarada Speed 192 outspeeds all non-Mega threats. Hatterene TrickRoom remains backup speed control. Metagross-Mega with Tough Claws is the endgame win condition once Gengar is removed.

decisions.rationale: Mamoswine's Life Orb Earthquake OHKOs both active Pokémon. Protecting Gengar while Mega Evolving immediately locks opposing positions with Shadow Tag and sets up 200 raw Speed for future turns. Switching Empoleon into Flying-type Dragonite safely nullifies Earthquake damage via ground immunity and preserves Multiscale against resisted or neutral incoming hits.

Meowscarada Protect (+4 priority) guarantees survival vs Gengar's Sludge Bomb (72-240% into 19% HP). Mamoswine Earthquake hits Gengar-Mega for 95-219%, likely removing the Shadow Tag threat. Dragonite is immune to EQ; its ExtremeSpeed (13-44%) won't KO Mamoswine at 90%. This safely eliminates the highest-priority target while preserving both Pokémon for the endgame Metagross-Mega plan.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega already Mega Evolved turn 1; Shadow Tag active prevents switching until Gengar faints. Meowscarada Focus Sash broken at 19% HP—extremely vulnerable to any super-effective hit. Mamoswine Life Orb recoil accumulating. Competitive Empoleon punishes stat drops; avoid Intimidate leads. Metagross-Mega with Tough Claws is primary endgame win condition once Gengar removed. Hatterene TrickRoom backup speed control. Dragonite Multiscale intact at 100%—priority moves halved. Preserve Mamoswine HP for late-game Ice Shard priority.

decisions.rationale: Dragonite's priority +2 Extreme Speed outspeeds Meowscarada and Mamoswine's Ice Shard (+1), guaranteeing the KO on 19% Meowscarada before it can act. Switching Gengar-Mega to Arcanine triggers Intimidate on Mamoswine, reducing its Earthquake damage into Arcanine while Dragonite is immune (Flying type). This preserves 100% HP Mega Gengar for endgame without risking a 15% Will-O-Wisp miss.
decisions.notebook: Opponent tends to lead Incineroar + Metagross. Empoleon punishes Intimidate via Competitive (+2 SpA). Opponent Mamoswine carries Life Orb with Ice Shard and Earthquake. Opponent Hatterene holds Mental Herb.

decisions.rationale: Meowscarada (192 Spe) outspeeds both foes. Flower Trick always crits, easily KOing 6% Arcanine even at -1 Atk. Mamoswine Rock Slide hits Dragonite 2x; Multiscale halves damage but Rock Slide can still break it or deal significant chip. This eliminates the immediate Flare Blitz threat while pressuring Dragonite. Avoiding Earthquake preserves Mamoswine HP and avoids hitting ally.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega Shadow Tag active; cannot switch until it faints. Metagross-Mega Tough Claws is primary endgame win condition. Preserve Mamoswine for late-game Ice Shard priority vs Dragonite. Hatterene TrickRoom backup. Competitive Empoleon punishes Intimidate/stat drops. Dragonite Multiscale intact at 100% HP halves first hit damage. Arcanine Charcoal boosts Flare Blitz. Meowscarada Focus Sash broken, extremely vulnerable.

decisions.rationale: Hatterene cannot be OHKOed by Arcanine Flare Blitz (34-94%) while Metagross can (47-124%). Hatterene KOs 6% Arcanine with any attack and preserves Metagross-Mega as endgame win condition. Mamoswine passes at -1 Atk, vulnerable to Flare Blitz OHKO.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega Shadow Tag locks my active Pokémon in until it faints. Metagross-Mega Tough Claws is primary endgame win condition - preserve. Arcanine at 6% HP is priority target but Flare Blitz threatens switch-ins; Hatterene safer than Metagross. Mamoswine Ice Shard priority useful vs Dragonite late-game but currently at -1 Atk. Opponent can switch their own Pokémon despite Shadow Tag. Competitive Empoleon punishes stat drops. Dragonite Multiscale intact at 100% halves first hit.

decisions.rationale: Dragonite's priority +2 Extreme Speed easily finishes Meowscarada (19% HP) before Meowscarada or Mamoswine's priority +1 Ice Shard can act. Arcanine uses Protect (+4 priority) to block incoming Ice Shard or Rock Slide, preserving its 7% HP and Intimidate pivot value for the remaining match against Metagross and Incineroar. Dragonite's Multiscale safely cushions any Ice Shard directed at it.

Arcanine at 6% is the priority target. Hatterene Psychic (206 SpA) should easily KO even through potential Sitrus on switch-in. Mamoswine Rock Slide hits both foes 2x SE; if Arcanine Protects, Dragonite takes heavy damage. If both Protect, we lose minimal value. Dazzling Gleam is inferior since Arcanine resists Fairy. Ice Shard at -1 Atk won't KO Dragonite reliably.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega Shadow Tag locks actives until it faints - opponent can still switch their own Pokémon out. Metagross-Mega Tough Claws is primary endgame win condition; preserve until Gengar is eliminated. Arcanine Intimidate drops Attack on switch-in; plan around -1 Atk for physical attackers. Competitive Empoleon punishes stat drops - avoid Intimidate or stat-lowering moves when Empoleon is active. Dragonite Multiscale halves first hit when at full HP; broken once damaged. Hatterene Magic Bounce reflects status moves - useful vs Will-O-Wisp. Mamoswine Life Orb recoil accumulates; track HP carefully. Priority moves (Ice Shard, Extreme Speed) crucial for speed control outside Trick Room.

decisions.rationale: Dragonite's Protect is 100% reliable this turn and completely denies Mamoswine's 4x Ice Shard. Arcanine outspeeds both opponents (161 Speed vs Mamoswine's max 132 and Hatterene's max 72) and can land a Charcoal-boosted Flare Blitz into Hatterene for heavy damage before Trick Room or an attack. If Arcanine faints to recoil, Gengar-Mega gains a free switch-in to activate Shadow Tag.

Gengar-Mega gives immediate speed control (200 Speed vs Mamoswine's 100-132) and Shadow Tag trapping. Next turn, Gengar outspeeds Mamoswine and Hatterene to finish Hatterene with Sludge Bomb/Shadow Ball or burn Mamoswine with Will-O-Wisp, while Dragonite's +2 priority Extreme Speed outspeeds Mamoswine's +1 Ice Shard.

Hatterene must Protect—both Gengar moves guarantee KO at 21%. Ice Shard into Dragonite at 79% deals 75-169%, very likely KO. Protect blocks Gengar's attack AND Dragonite's ExtremeSpeed (+2) since Protect blocks all targeting moves. If Dragonite survives (low roll), we reassess next turn. Removing Dragonite now reduces opponent's offensive pressure significantly while preserving Metagross-Mega as endgame win condition.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega Shadow Tag locks actives; opponent can still switch their own mons. Metagross-Mega Tough Claws is primary endgame—preserve until Gengar eliminated. Hatterene Magic Bounce reflects Will-O-Wisp. Dragonite Multiscale already broken. Mamoswine Life Orb recoil accumulates; monitor HP. Competitive Empoleon punishes stat drops—avoid Intimidate/stat-lowering moves when Empoleon active. Priority moves crucial for speed control outside TR. Arcanine Intimidate already applied (-1 Atk on Mamoswine).

decisions.rationale: Gengar-Mega's raw Speed (200) naturally outspeeds Hatterene (44-72) and Mamoswine (100-132) without Trick Room active. Sludge Bomb is 100% accurate and guaranteed to KO Hatterene's 21% HP before it can act. Dragonite's +2 priority Extreme Speed hits Mamoswine before Ice Shard (+1) or Earthquake, reducing Mamoswine's HP into range for Gengar-Mega to outspeed and finish on turn 6.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Hatterene at 21% must Protect (reduced rate but still ~33%) to survive Gengar's 2x SE Shadow Ball/Sludge Bomb. Mamoswine Earthquake does 91.6-213.3% to Gengar-Mega - high KO chance. If Gengar falls, Empoleon alone vs Mamoswine+Hatterene with Metagross in reserve. If EQ misses KO, Empoleon may Hydro Pump Mamoswine but we still have Metagross endgame. Trick Room loses Hatterene to Gengar's faster attack. This line maximizes Gengar elimination chance while preserving Hatterene.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega Shadow Tag locks actives - must KO or force opponent to switch their own mon. Metagross-Mega Tough Claws is primary endgame; preserve until Gengar eliminated. Hatterene Magic Bounce reflects Will-O-Wisp. Mamoswine Life Orb recoil accumulates - at 30% HP, one more recoil could faint. Competitive Empoleon punishes stat drops. Priority moves (Ice Shard, Bullet Punch) crucial for speed control outside TR. Protect success rate halves each consecutive use.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Gengar-Mega (200 Spe) outspeeds Mamoswine (100-132 Spe) and guarantees the KO at 29% HP with 100% accurate Shadow Ball before Earthquake. Empoleon (80 Spe) outspeeds Hatterene (44-72 Spe) and guarantees the KO at 21% HP with 100% accurate Flash Cannon. Cross-targeting both foes guarantees at least one KO even if Mamoswine Protects or Hatterene gets a consecutive Protect roll, securing an immediate win or unlosable 2v1 endgame.
decisions.notebook: Opponent leads Incineroar + Metagross. Opponent Mamoswine is Life Orb with Ice Shard and Earthquake. Opponent Hatterene holds Mental Herb.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Metagross)
decisions.rationale: Hatterene faints to Gengar's guaranteed-first Shadow Ball, but Trick Room (-7 priority) still sets up. Metagross Protects to guarantee survival and Mega Evolves for Tough Claws. Next turn under TR, Mega Metagross (base 110, Adamant) outspeeds Gengar-Mega (base 110, Timid) and attacks first with 1.3x boosted Meteor Mash. This preserves our win condition while sacrificing Hatterene for field control.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega Shadow Tag locks both actives - must KO Gengar or force opponent to switch it out. Trick Room + Mega Metagross Tough Claws is primary win condition. Hatterene at 21% is sacrificial for TR setup. Protect success rate: 1/2, 1/3, 1/4 on consecutive uses. Competitive Empoleon punishes stat drops. Base Metagross Speed 100, Mega 110; Gengar-Mega base 110 Timid - under TR, Mega Metagross goes first regardless.

decisions.rationale: Gengar-Mega outspeeds Metagross (200 vs max 162) and deals 77-140% with 2x SE Shadow Ball. Metagross's Bullet Punch cannot KO Gengar-Mega (29-42% max). Empoleon outspeeds Hatterene (80 vs max 72) and guarantees a KO on the 21% HP Hatterene with 2x SE Flash Cannon before Hatterene can act or set up Trick Room. This leaves us in a winning 2v1 position.

Meteor Mash on Gengar-Mega has 45.5-107.4% damage with ~50%+ OHKO rate. Even if it fails, Metagross survives Shadow Ball (59-97%) and can finish Gengar next turn. Empoleon is slower and cannot OHKO. Breaking Shadow Tag lock is priority. Protect's 50% success rate is too risky. Bullet Punch lacks damage.
decisions.notebook: Gengar-Mega Shadow Tag locks both actives - must KO Gengar to break lock. Meteor Mash 45.5-107.4% on Gengar, Shadow Ball 59-97% on Metagross. Empoleon Hydro Pump 27-48% on Metagross. Competitive Empoleon punishes stat drops. Under Trick Room, Mega Metagross outspeeds Gengar. Protect success rate halves each consecutive use.

decisions.rationale: Gengar outspeeds Metagross-Mega (200 vs max 162) and deals 67.9-120% with super-effective STAB Shadow Ball. Flash Cannon provides 100% accurate chip (13.4-23.9%) to secure or nearly secure the KO. Even if Metagross survives on low HP, all three of its attacking moves (Meteor Mash, Bullet Punch, Ice Punch) are 4x resisted by Empoleon, guaranteeing a win on the following turn.
decisions.notebook: Game 3 won. Opponent Metagross-Mega carries Meteor Mash, Bullet Punch, Ice Punch, Protect. Mamoswine is Adamant Life Orb.

reflections.summary: The team-preview selection of Mega Metagross, Mamoswine, Hatterene, and Meowscarada was structurally mismatched against the opponent's Mega Gengar + Competitive Empoleon core. The lack of a Shadow Tag disruptor, Empoleon check, or committed Trick Room setup left Mega Metagross trapped and outsped, forcing sequential unfavorable trades and a 1v0 loss.
reflections.adjustment: Replace Meowscarada with a fast Taunt/Encore user or dedicated Empoleon counter, and commit to Trick Room on turn 1 to ensure Mega Metagross outspeeds Gengar and can safely break the lock without forced HP trades.
reflections.notebook: Opponent favors Mega Gengar (Shadow Tag) + Competitive Empoleon core to force favorable trades. Dragonite runs Multiscale + Extremespeed for priority cleanup; Arcanine provides Intimidate/Flare Blitz pressure. Opponent avoids Aerodactyl/Clefable against this roster. Strategic fact: Mega Metagross is outsped by Gengar without Trick Room and lacks safe disengage options from Shadow Tag. Future plan: Bring a dedicated Shadow Tag disruptor (Taunt/Encore) and Empoleon resist. If Hatterene is brought, commit to Trick Room turn 1 to neutralize speed disadvantage and enable safe lock-breaking.

reflections.summary: Bringing Mega Gengar and Empoleon alongside dual priority (Dragonite and Arcanine) was effective against the opponent's build: early priority eliminated Meowscarada before it could generate momentum, while Mega Gengar and Empoleon leveraged typing and Shadow Tag to force optimal endgame trades against Mega Metagross and Hatterene.
reflections.adjustment: Preserve Arcanine's HP more carefully instead of spending it on Flare Blitz recoil early, keeping Intimidate cycling available to soften physical threats like Mamoswine and Mega Metagross for a cleaner late game.
reflections.notebook: Opponent full roster specs revealed across series: Metagross-Mega (Adamant, Meteor Mash/Bullet Punch/Ice Punch/Protect); Mamoswine (Adamant Life Orb, Ice Shard/Earthquake/Rock Slide/Protect); Hatterene (Quiet Mental Herb, Psychic/Dazzling Gleam/Trick Room/Protect); Meowscarada (Jolly Focus Sash, Flower Trick/Knock Off/U-turn/Protect); Incineroar (Careful Sitrus Berry, Fake Out/Flare Blitz/Darkest Lariat/Parting Shot); Rotom-Heat (Modest Leftovers, Thunderbolt/Overheat/Will-O-Wisp/Protect). Dual priority leads (Dragonite + Arcanine) reliably punish Meowscarada; Empoleon walls Hatterene/Mamoswine ice/psychic spam.
